page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, right of centre. Along the left edge, the cut-off fragments of the facing page's text belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: consenfa, doctoralem hanc quam per- multis jam annis plurimum ornaverat mihi succesfori designato reliquit (fuit id æstiva vacatione circiter Kal. Sexti- les:)discessi tum hinc ea mente, ut prox- imo termino Michaelis certo etiam die constituto, Kal. sc. Novembribus re- vertetur res domesticas interea compo- nerem, eaque curarem quæ reditum ma- turarent. Quid multa? Curo, compono, &c totus in hac sum. Glifcere jam tum simultates publicæ, magis magisq, indi- es universa in pejus ruere, ardere pas- sim omnia discordiis civilibus: versari in ore, in auribus, in oculis omnium nil nisi bellici apparatus, armorum strepi- tus, tumultus militum. Ego tamen pergo, sed segnius aliquanto quam oc- caperam, vasa colligere, farcinas com- plicare, capsas &c cistulas rebus ne- cessariis implere ex quibus una, mag- no meo cum infortunio, paulo longius domo mea eo fine premissa ut huc com--

page.notes: The first word is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Some ampersands are printed in a ligature form and read as "&". Underlined "Q" in "Quid" is set in italic. The final word "modius" stands right-aligned below the last line and is taken as the catchword. Printed hyphen at "com-" is kept. The left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are omitted.
